title: NWIS Historical Event Schema
description: Standard schema for individual historical events extracted from source documentation.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the historical event.

event_type.description: Normalized event taxonomy value (e.g., STUCK_PIPE, KICK, UNKNOWN).

verification_status.description: Status of the historical event based on the certainty of the source.

conflict_status.description: Indicates if multiple historical sources disagree about this event.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 start timestamp of the event. Null if unknown.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp of the event. Null if unknown.

depth_start.description: Starting depth of the event. Null if unknown.

depth_end.description: Ending depth of the event. Null if unknown.

data_origin.description: Provenance of this record to distinguish real history from synthetic tests.

original_event_type.description: The exact wording used in the source document before normalization.

confidence.description: Confidence in the extraction and normalization process [0.0 - 1.0].

notes.description: Optional human notes about this event alignment.
